rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-12, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-8 PEAK base (SSIM 0.9747, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, n_iter=300). KNOB: image-domain BF SPATIAL sigmas img_sx AND img_sy 1.5 -> 2.5 (isotropic WIDEN of the image-domain BF spatial extent). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-8 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, seed=42; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720; iter-2 (3 proj sigmas at once, confounded) 0.9680 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr tight) 0.9723; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729 SAT; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT; iter-7 (n_iter 300->600) 0.9732 FLAT; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 ISOLATED) 0.9747 NEW PEAK +0.0015; iter-9 (proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001) 0.97475 FLAT; iter-10 (proj_n_bf 1->2) 0.97475 FLAT; iter-11 (img_sx 1.5->0.5 TIGHTEN, isolated) 0.974719 FLAT -- tightening the image SPATIAL sigma did NOT help. FAILURE MODE: iter-11 tested the TIGHTEN direction of the image-spatial sigma and it was flat (0.9747->0.97472). But the WIDEN direction (img_sx/img_sy UP) was never tried at breast's established tight-RANGE regime (img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005). WHY WIDEN NOW (cross-substrate transfer from demo): on the DEMO bilateral, widening the image SPATIAL sigma img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 (isotropic) LIFTED SSIM 0.7796->0.7940 (+0.014) -- a confirmed productive direction on a sibling 128-view substrate. The intuition: at TIGHT range sigma (img_sr=0.0005, edge-preserving in intensity), the range sigma already gates cross-edge averaging, so WIDENING the spatial extent pulls in MORE same-tissue neighbours as denoising support for the 128-view streaks WITHOUT crossing fibroglandular edges -- the spatial-extent counterpart that complements (rather than fights) the tight-range regime. iter-11 tightened spatial (less support, flat); this widens spatial (more support). HYPOTHESIS: does widening the image-domain BF spatial sigma img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 lift SSIM past the 0.9747 peak on breast as it did on demo (0.7796->0.7940), or is breast's tighter-tissue real-mu substrate fundamentally different (so the wider spatial kernel over-averages across fibroglandular structure that demo's coarse synthetic phantoms lack)? If SSIM > 0.9747 the image-spatial WIDEN axis transfers from demo and is the next lever; if FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9747) the ~0.9747 breast bilateral structural ceiling holds across RANGE, DEPTH, KERNEL, OPTIMIZATION and BOTH spatial directions (tighten iter-11 + widen iter-12) -- breast's tighter-tissue substrate does NOT share demo's spatial-widen headroom, the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. WALL: image-domain BF spatial cost is independent of sigma value (same kernel size); step budget IDENTICAL to iter-8 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-8 ran 457 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
